_readme: Hand corrections. 'endpoints' maps a project (DESC:<ProjectID without spaces> or GA:<TEAMS>) to station names when the title alone is misleading; explain corrections in endpoint_notes. 'points' maps STATE:<normalized name> to a hand-sited coordinate; every entry must say why and may specify confidence (low/medium/high) and radiusMi > 0. Defaults remain high and 0.5 miles, so uncertain placements must set both explicitly.

SC:v c summer.why: V.C. Summer Nuclear Station (VCS1/VCS2 switchyard), Jenkinsville, Fairfield County; published plant location

endpoint_notes.DESC:6367D: Riverport is a tap off the Jasper-Okatie corridor; the tap point is not public, so the project is placed on its host line with the line's uncertainty. Its uncertainty radius is set to half the 6.5-mile host line plus a margin (3.5 mi).
endpoint_notes.DESC:6853B-F: Scout is a customer substation; the description says the work modifies the VCS1 and Killian terminals.
endpoint_notes.GA:21319: 2025 GA ITS Ten-Year Plan (2026-2035), Teams 21319, p.181: the description explicitly places the capacitor bank at Ellenwood substation. Rainbow Drive in the title is an area name, not the worksite. Public source: https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/225600/106866
